name: DOE EM: Savannah River tank-waste cleanup marks record risk reduction
known_limitations: DOE distinguishes processed radioactivity from natural decay and reports gallons and curies under different denominators. The agency attribution is not an independent causal evaluation, and forecast savings are separate from realized treatment output.
source_owner: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
